key_idea: With re-rolls on ties, die A beats die B with probability wins/(wins+losses) over the 36 face pairs, so John needs wins>=losses and wins+losses>0 against both other dice.
sketch: For each ordered pair of dice count face pairs where A is higher (w) and lower (l). John's die i is safe if for both other dice w>=l and w+l>0 (if all 36 pairs tie nobody ever wins, so his win probability is 0). Output the smallest safe index or 'No dice'. Pitfall: the all-ties case, and identical dice give exactly 1/2 which is acceptable.
